comment: Ratchet-only floors. 'history' must be monotonically non-decreasing (enforced by dogfood-gates.mjs floor-ratchet). Domain floors are minimum percentages for ALL FOUR metrics (lines/branches/functions/statements where the tool supports them). Phase 0 seeds 0/100 so the first run is green; every later change may only raise values. Final phase: every domain floor = 100, orphanFloorPercent = 0.
